note: Noisy runs train on outcomes flipped at rate f and select on the stored flipped outcomes. The flips are nested across rates (one draw per interaction from the same stream), so the rates are paired. Channel-scale ECE scores the stored top-1 against f + (1 - 2f) x correct; the reference is the clean run's top-1 mapped through f + (1 - 2f) p. The selection criterion's excess is its floor minus its value, the floor being -H(f) for flipped outcomes and 0 for clean ones.

uncorrected.note: ece is the uncorrected ECE: the stored top-1 probability against clean correctness (the gold label), before any inversion. accuracy_change is noisy minus clean accuracy, paired; direct_brier_change_minus_positive_sft_change is direct_brier's change minus positive_sft's, paired, positive when direct_brier loses less.
